info.name: Smart Migration
info.summary: Migrate SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and file shares to Nextcloud — with deep discovery and interactive BI
info.description:
Provides a Nextcloud interface for defining and monitoring MigrateDMS SMART Migration jobs.
Create a job for each SharePoint, OneDrive or Teams document library — or file share — and run deep file discovery before you move anything. Interactive business intelligence shows exactly what's there: volume, age, structure and the content that needs attention first. You plan the migration on a complete picture of your data.
The same reporting tracks progress while the migration runs, and becomes your documentation of what was moved once it's done.
Discovery, migration and run history all stay visible in Nextcloud, with reports delivered to Nextcloud Files.
Requires SMART Migration. See https://www.migratedms.com
info.author: Steen Jakobsen
